title: 2021 Prairie's alley stable, its gable clad in tin
items: The brick stable behind 2021 Prairie Avenue now stands at the size and place the 1911 insurance map gives it.
Its one-storey south end is built, and above it the gable's upper storey is grey sheet tin, as the map notes.
A carriage door with a loft hatch and hoist faces the alley; a brick path leads to the house.
